[[File:Strongbones chathead.png|left|130px]]
'''Strongbones''' is an undead goblin priest fought in the [[Land of the Goblins]] quest. He is the fifth and final priest fought in the [[Goblin Temple]]'s crypt in an attempt to find the location of [[Yu'biusk]], which he reveals to the player. After the quest, [[Hopespear]] asks the player to free the souls of the goblin priests in [[Hopespear's Will]] miniquest, where he is fought again and put to rest on Yu'biusk. 

He is also the most intelligent of the five high goblin priests. He calls many [[Skoblin (Strongbones)|skoblins]] to aid him, and if one is dead, it will be replaced immediately by another.

==Trivia==
* He seems to know that the [[Zanik|chosen commander]] is a female, although the goblin prophet, [[Hopespear]], doesn't know it.
* He speaks the [[common tongue]] fluently and properly; this is because he was alive during a time when [[goblins]] were a highly intelligent race.
* He should not be fought with area of effect abilities, as if a skoblin minion dies after Strongbones does by any means, your conversation will be interupted.
